messages:
sam (CS): Sunfire go-live tentative Wed 08:00 PT. Need final signoff on quota windows, short smoke, and autoscale headroom for their bulk migration at +65m. Who can take watch?

riley (SRE): I can. Proposed ramp: 5m priming -> 8m at 20% -> 15m at 55% -> 25m soak. Autoscale rule: scale up if cpu_95>0.9 OR queue_ms>1600 for 2m; scale down after 10m stable below 60%. Rollback if errors >4% for 10m or p95>3s for 12m.

mona (Infra): Add KV prefix priming (4m) before ramp. We'll pin model to sun-v1.0-quant for first 18h to reduce variance. Also suggest limiting long-context concurrency to 8 for first 90m.

lee (Solutions): Sunfire wants an embeddings cap for the first hour (100 rps) and a short smoke at 08:30 PT. They plan a big migration at +65m and will give a 10m heads-up. Also request a simple dashboard link for per-route latency.

sam (CS): @mona confirm model pin and concurrency cap? @riley can you add a temporary headroom rule we can paste into the runbook? I'll tell Sunfire to hold migration until we give the go.

mona (Infra): Confirmed: model pinned sun-v1.0-quant for 18h; fallback staged sun-v0.9-fp16. Long-context concurrency set to 8 via proxy. Adding notes to CS-8301.

riley (SRE): Adding headroom: temporary_surge multiplier 1.9x for 5m if import spike detected within first 90m. Pasting autoscale snippet to CS-8301 (short form here):

```
{"scale_up":"cpu_95>0.9 or queue_ms>1600","up_window":"2m","scale_down":"cpu_5<0.6","down_window":"10m","burst":{"factor":1.9,"duration":"5m","trigger_window":"first_90m"},"embeddings_temp_quota":"100rps"}
```

sam (CS): Nice. Who runs the smoke at 08:30?

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-8301 created: Sunfire dedicated bring-up orchestration. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8301

lee (Solutions): I'll run the smoke with Sunfire ops. Plan: 60 synthetic users, mixed chat+embeddings, 7m. Will record feedback and surface any renewal concerns.

mona (Infra): I'll start the KV priming job at 07:50 PT and preheat the embeddings cache. Fallback toggle ready in control plane.

riley (SRE): Autoscale + rollback posted to CS-8301. I'll also add an alert to oncall for the rollback thresholds.

sam (CS): EOD checklist: 1) riley post autoscale + alerts to ticket, 2) mona add model pin + prewarm + fallback link, 3) lee confirm smoke + capture feedback, 4) I'll send customer-facing timeline and runbook. Aim to close prep by EOD today. :white_check_mark:
